botCommands.effort: Show or change default reasoning effort
botCommands.rhythm: Show or change autonomous wake rhythm
botCommands.computer: Use Computer Use for one desktop task
botCommands.stop: Interrupt current reply and pause active goal

startup.intro: This is a new Telegram mainline session. I need to complete startup first: read the configured context files, recover the current project notes, operating boundaries, and handoff context.
startup.extraContextRule: If this turn involves autonomous action, rhythm, mainline maintenance, remote maintenance, tools, or project-specific notes, I will continue reading the necessary configured or project context.
startup.wakeIntro: This is a Telegram mainline autonomous wake. I need to complete startup first: read the configured context files and recover the current project notes, operating boundaries, and handoff context.
startup.replyRule: After reading them, I will not output a long startup report. I will reply naturally to the user and keep the same context for later conversation.
startup.deliveryRule: The current entry point is Telegram. When I truly need to deliver a local file back to Telegram, I append <tg_send_file path="local file path" /> at the end of my reply. I do not use that marker for ordinary chat or analysis.
startup.wakeRule: After startup, I will follow the autonomous-action rules and advance one small, finishable work package. I will not create a complex process or enter an extra state machine.

telegramInput.noReadableQuoted: content: (no readable text or attachment summary)
telegramInput.currentImages: content: (the current message contains {count} image(s); see following image inputs.)
telegramInput.currentNoText: content: (the current message has no readable text.)
telegramInput.imageOnly: (the current message contains an image; see following image input.)
telegramInput.fileBinaryStatus: downloaded; file body was not expanded

runDetails.title: Codex run details{suffix} ({state})
runDetails.expandHint: Expand to view tool calls and output summaries.
runDetails.truncated: ...TG run details were truncated; full events and raw tool output are stored in {path}

rhythm.fallbackMessage: [Codex Mainline]: Knock knock. Start autonomous action according to the current context.
rhythm.title: Codex rhythm:
rhythm.note: Note: only minute values with the m suffix are accepted. Changes are written to settings immediately and the next wake time is recalculated without restart.

fallbackPrompt: You have been working for a while. Naturally close out this turn, record necessary results or follow-up plans, then stop and rest for a while.

compaction.started: Codex Mainline is compacting context. Please wait.
compaction.busy: Codex Mainline is compacting context, so this command is not being run now. Please send it again later.
compaction.queued: Codex Mainline is compacting context. This message has been queued and will be processed in order after compaction completes.
compaction.failedNext: Codex Mainline context compaction failed. Switching to {step} and sending a pause turn to trigger native compaction recovery.
compaction.failed: Codex Mainline context compaction failed and is waiting for the next recovery step.
compaction.timedOutNext: Codex Mainline context compaction did not emit a completion event. Switching to {step} and sending a pause turn to trigger native compaction recovery.
compaction.timedOut: Codex Mainline context compaction did not emit a completion event and is waiting for the next recovery step.
compaction.exhausted: Codex Mainline context compaction recovery was attempted {maxAttempts} time(s) and automatic recovery has stopped. Later turns will temporarily use gpt-5.4-mini low; the default model is restored after compaction succeeds.
compaction.pausePrompt: [Codex Mainline]: Context compaction failed and recovery mode is active. Pause all actions: do not read files, call tools, continue tasks, or start new analysis. Reply only with: paused, waiting for context compaction recovery.
compaction.resumePrompt: [Codex Mainline]: Knock knock. The failed context-compaction chain has recovered and compaction succeeded; continue the task.
compaction.proactiveResumePrompt: [Codex Mainline]: Knock knock. Proactive context compaction completed; continue the task from before compaction.
compaction.recoveryOverLimit: pending, but automatic retry limit has been exceeded

serverOverloaded.continuePrompt: [Codex Mainline]: The previous turn failed because the OpenAI service was busy (serverOverloaded). Continue the task from the current context. Keep the reply focused; if the task is already complete, close it out briefly.

status.title: Codex Mainline TG Status
status.contextNone: context: no snapshot yet (updates after the next model event)

effort.note: Note: this immediately changes the default reasoning effort for future turns and writes settings to disk. A currently running turn is not changed mid-flight.
effort.activeTurnNote: A currently running turn will not change mid-flight; this takes effect on the next turn.
effort.nextTurnNote: This takes effect on the next turn; no restart is required.

language.note: Note: this immediately changes future bridge-layer mechanical output and writes settings to disk. A currently running turn is not changed mid-flight.
language.nextTurnNote: Future bridge-layer mechanical output will use the new language.

session.newThreadNext: (not created; the next turn will create one)
session.note: Note: this only disconnects the current binding so the next turn creates a new Codex thread. Old sessions remain in native Codex App / CLI history.
session.compacting: Codex Mainline is compacting context, so session switching is postponed.
session.activeTurn: Codex Mainline still has an active turn. Wait for it to finish, then send {command}.
session.resumeFailed: Could not resume that thread_id; binding was not changed: {error}
switched: The next normal message will enter the bound session.
cleared: Current TG mainline thread binding cleared.
The next normal message or autonomous wake will create a new Codex thread and reread startup docs.
The old session remains visible in native Codex App / CLI history; to return, send:

usage: Note: searches native Codex chats / threads and returns titles, times, thread_id values, and snippets.
Switch back by copying /session use <thread_id> from the result.
history.title: History search: {query}
history.more: More results are available; the TG command currently returns only the first page.
history.unsupported: The running app-server does not support thread/search yet. Restart TG mainline so it starts a newer Codex app-server, then try /history <keyword> again.

goal.title: Native Codex goal:
goal.note1: Note: these commands only operate on the native Codex goal; they do not write long-term project goals.
goal.note2: Note: /stop requests interruption of the current turn and pauses the active goal.
goal.nothingToClear: There is no Codex thread or goal to clear.
goal.nothingToPause: There is no native Codex goal to pause.
goal.nothingToResume: There is no native Codex goal to resume.
goal.nothingToEdit: There is no native Codex goal to edit. Use /goal <objective> to create one.
goal.needThread: There is no Codex thread yet. Send a normal message to start the session before setting /goal.

stop.pausedGoal: Also paused the active goal to avoid starting the next pursuit automatically.

usage: Example: /plan improve a beef-and-tomato stew recipe.
plan.finished: Plan generated. You can reply with revisions directly; to execute, say so clearly in a normal message.
plan.activeTurn: Codex Mainline still has an active turn. Wait for it to finish, then send /plan <content>.

usage: Usage: /computer <desktop task to perform on Windows>
Note: this command requests the Computer Use plugin at the start of the turn and follows the official local instructions to connect to the Windows control interface.
computer.activeTurn: Codex Mainline still has an active turn. Wait for it to finish, then send /computer <task>.
computer.requestLine1: Use the official Computer Use plugin to handle the Windows desktop task below.
computer.requestLine2: First read the local computer-use plugin instructions, connect with the official minimal bootstrap, and verify lightly with sky.list_apps(); do not decide it is unavailable before completing bootstrap.

main.unsupportedMessage: I cannot handle this Telegram message type yet: {kind}.
main.unsupportedSticker: This sticker is animated/video, so it cannot be converted into an image input yet. Static stickers are supported.
main.activeAppendFallback: Appending to the previous active turn failed. Please handle the following user message naturally as a new turn.
